message: Hey John, just checking in. You seemed a bit distant last time we met. Is everything okay at home?
John, I'm really worried about you and Linda. These arguments are getting worse. Have you thought more about that counselor I suggested?
I can't believe we're going through this again. We need to figure things out before it's too late.
You did an amazing job with the team this year, John. They're lucky to have you.
Hey, did you talk to Linda after our chat? It's important to keep the communication open.
I'm proud to tell you that I got the promotion at Anderson & Clark! We should celebrate this weekend.
Don't forget we're meeting up on Saturday. Hope to see you in better spirits, buddy.
Great practice today, team! Remember to rest up and stay hydrated.
I'm here for you, John. We'll get through this family stuff together.
Can we talk when you get home? It's about the argument we had this morning.
